managed_equity: sum(raw managed-asset total balance * canonical mark)
available_capital: raw USDC availBal minus canonical unreflected internal reservations

baseline.activation: explicit Product Owner approval and exact immutable artifact fingerprint
baseline.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no floats
baseline.fingerprint: SHA-256 over all artifact fields except artifact_fingerprint
baseline.mark_selection: latest fully closed canonical 1m candle before PLAN_CREATED_AT
baseline.apply_financial_evidence: exact approved artifact only; no reconstruction
baseline.stale_balance_policy: apply approved historical anchor; fresh balance changes do not mutate or block it

timestamps.accepted_at: approved cutover candidate frozen in artifact
